whyOtherDeviceFailed: SHA-256 token_hash is one-way. create_link returned the raw token once; the SPA cached {id,url,expiresAt} in localStorage. get_link returned metadata only, so another browser showed an active link with no URL.
localStorageStores: dalia-claims-cust-link:<claimId> → { id, url, expiresAt } (convenience cache only)
chosenFix: HMAC-SHA256(domain-separated service key, link_id|claim_id). Authorized staff who canWork the claim reconstruct the same token via reveal_link. Public lookup still uses token_hash. No plaintext token column.

rejected.storeRawTokenInDb: Owner-forbidden. DB/backup leak would expose every customer URL.
rejected.encryptedTokenColumn: Would need schema/migration — stop until Owner approval.
rejected.rotateOnOtherDeviceOnly: Clear UX but kills the customer's existing URL. Kept as explicit «צור קישור חדש» and as fallback for pre-HMAC rows.
